name: web-to-md
title: Web to Markdown
description: Convert webpages to Markdown — save to a file, copy to the clipboard, or preview inside Raycast. Works with the active browser tab or any URL.
author: BryanB

preferences.name: fileNameStyle
preferences.title: Filename Style
preferences.description: How to name the generated file.

preferences.name: includeFrontmatter
preferences.title: Frontmatter
preferences.description: Include YAML frontmatter at the top of the Markdown file.
preferences.label: Include frontmatter

preferences.name: externalFallbackEnabled
preferences.title: External Fallback
preferences.description: If local extraction fails, optionally fetch content from an external reader service (sends the URL to a third party).
preferences.label: Enable external fallback

preferences.name: externalFallbackPrefix
preferences.title: External Fallback Prefix
preferences.description: Prefix used to build the fallback URL, e.g. https://r.jina.ai/http:// or https://r.jina.ai/https:// (prefix should include scheme and any trailing slashes).

commands.name: convert-tab-to-file
commands.title: Save Tab to File
commands.description: Convert the active browser tab to Markdown and save it to your output directory.

commands.name: convert-tab-to-clipboard
commands.title: Copy Tab to Clipboard
commands.description: Convert the active browser tab to Markdown and copy it to the clipboard.

commands.name: convert-url-to-file
commands.title: Save URL to File
commands.description: Convert a URL to Markdown and save it to your output directory. Falls back to clipboard if no URL is given.

commands.name: convert-url-to-clipboard
commands.title: Save URL to Clipboard
commands.description: Convert a URL to Markdown and copy it to the clipboard. Falls back to clipboard URL if no URL is given.

commands.name: display-tab
commands.title: Display Tab as Markdown
commands.description: Preview the active browser tab as Markdown inside Raycast, then copy or save.

commands.name: display-url
commands.title: Display URL as Markdown
commands.description: Preview any URL as Markdown inside Raycast, then copy or save. Falls back to clipboard or a form when no URL is given.
